title: Spiraling Magenta Vortex
description: An abstract painting featuring dynamic, swirling brushstrokes in vibrant shades of magenta, hot pink, and deep blue. The composition consists of multiple overlapping spirals, loops, and curved forms that create a sense of energetic, clockwise rotational movement against a white background.
prompt: abstract painting with bold energetic swirls and overlapping circular brushstrokes in vibrant magenta, hot pink, and deep ultramarine blue. Multiple vortex-like spirals and looping forms create dynamic clockwise motion. Expressive thick paint strokes with visible texture on a clean white canvas background, contemporary abstract style with high contrast and fluid movement.
